name: Great Game Serengeti

features.name: Hunts
features.description: Hit animals become coins, and four-star animals become traps of at least 10x that collect other values.

features.name: Stampede Reveals
features.description: A pre-spin event that always lands a Hunting Season symbol and removes low-paying symbols.

features.name: Lion Bar bonus
features.description: In the 4 FS bonus, a progressive Lion Bar awards Stampede Reveals during the free spins.

review:
The savanna follow-up to Great Game Rockies, with the same Hunt: five shots at targets above the reels. One- to three-star animals become coins, while four-star animals become traps worth at least 10x that collect everything. Wilds can multiply up to five of them by up to 20x.

Stampede Reveals can kick in before a spin lands, always bringing a Hunt and no low symbols. Three FS give 8 spins, four give 10 with a Lion Bar, five unlock the Epic bonus. Rated 3/5, 5,000x max, RTP 96.29% down to 86.24%.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 86.24% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
